current_evidence: Calderdale's 'Validation Requirements for Planning Applications' page (at Grokbot's URL and at /validation-requirements, 'Updated: 25th June 2026') says the National and Local Validation Requirements list is adopted, and to view the list it links to the Objective consultation portal event 38284. That portal page returned a client error, so its own date could not be read. planning.data.gov.uk records a period start of 2023-12-14 for the list, but that is register data, not document text.

issues.detail: Grokbot recorded the link as unreadable ('Link only (not readable: blocked/404/login)') and captured no requirements. All 18 application-type rows say 'Not covered', yet the page loads normally and points to the adopted list.
issues.evidence: Page text: 'The National and Local Validation Requirements list is adopted... To view the List, please visit: National and Local Planning Validation Requirements'

issues.detail: Grokbot's URL is a guidance landing page, not the list itself. Its local content is mostly residential annexe guidance and old fees; the requirements list is on the council's Objective consultation portal.
issues.evidence: Link 'National and Local Planning Validation Requirements' -> https://calderdale-consult.objective.co.uk/kse/event/38284

issues.detail: No Calderdale local requirements are captured. The landing page alone names a Climate Change Statement Proforma (new to the list) and a supporting statement for residential annexe proposals (strongly advised; explains occupancy, relationship to host dwelling and shared rooms). It also notes that a Construction Management Plan and a Utilities Statement are no longer needed at validation. The full list could not be read here.
issues.evidence: 'A Climate Change Statement Proforma has been created'; 'Construction Management Plan is no longer needed at validation stage'; 'Utilities Statement is no longer needed at validation stage'

issues.detail: The list date is blank. The council page shows 'Updated: 25th June 2026' and says the list is adopted, but gives no adoption date. planning.data.gov.uk gives a period start of 2023-12-14.

summary: Grokbot's Calderdale link loads fine, but it is a landing page that sends readers to the adopted National and Local Validation Requirements list on the council's Objective portal, which could not be fetched. Grokbot captured nothing for Calderdale, so the whole local list is missing from the workbook.
